_comment: Live image host for proposal option photos. When 'base_url' is set, generate.py HOT-LINKS each option image as <base_url>/<system-slug>/<tier>.jpg instead of baking a bundled copy in. To CHANGE a photo you do NOT touch this skill: replace the image in the Google Drive source folder and re-publish the host (see SKILL.md > 'Where proposal images come from'). Set base_url to an empty string to fall back to the bundled/base64 images.
